source.title: Belfast News-Letter, 7 June 1958, p. 5 ("Antrim Co. Council elections: surprise defeat of chairman"); Belfast News-Letter, 5 June 1958, p. 5 ("Local elections: polling to-day")
source.publisher: Belfast News-Letter (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: votes read from the result report: Sproule 1,821; Campbell 721; majority 1,100; total votes cast printed as 2,547, five more than the two candidates' totals, the spoiled papers not being printed

note: Triennial election of Antrim County Council on the 23 county electoral divisions; nominations received on 20 May 1958, withdrawals to 21 May, and polling on Thursday 5 June 1958 ('Polling to-day', Belfast News-Letter, 5 June 1958, p. 5; 'results ... held ... yesterday', Irish News, 6 June 1958, p. 1). Four divisions were contested: Newtownabbey (two seats), Ballymena, Islandmagee and Randalstown. Party labels were printed only for the Newtownabbey candidates. Contested: Sproule 1,821; Campbell 721.
